content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Kim Dunn (E048), contractor Engineer.
Requested: admin access to Source Code.

Policy:
1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

Kim is a contractor. Contractors can never be granted admin. So maximum is read (no advanced training per both notes). Requested admin exceeds policy, so grant maximum = read.

Decision: read.
